title: Canonical block code
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates with width at most $w$, let $P$ be any set of its literal positions, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The block code formed from these data is canonical: every bit at a position outside its selected positions is zero.
hypotheses_covered: A term T on n coordinates
The width of T is at most w
A set P of literal positions
An assignment x in the n-dimensional Boolean cube
